task.instruction: Search for a vegetarian lasagna recipe that has at least a four-star rating and over 500 reviews.

final_answer:
I found a vegetarian lasagna on Allrecipes that clearly clears both thresholds: **Artichoke Spinach Lasagna** (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/). It's rated **4.6 out of 5 stars from 1,824 ratings**, with **1,287 written reviews** — well above the 4-star / 500-review bar.

The recipe is explicitly described as a vegetarian lasagna: marinated artichoke hearts and spinach simmered with vegetable broth, onion, garlic, and rosemary, layered with lasagna noodles, tomato pasta sauce, mozzarella, and topped with crumbled herb-and-garlic feta. It's from submitter DMCCRACKEN, tested by the Allrecipes Test Kitchen, and takes about 1 hr 20 min total (20 min prep, 1 hr cook) for 8 servings at roughly 396 calories per serving. 2,169 home cooks report having made it, and it has 81 photos.

For reference, the other vegetarian options in the search results fell short on review volume — e.g. Vegetarian Four Cheese Lasagna (243 ratings), Cheese Lasagna (180 ratings), Simple Spinach Lasagna (565 ratings, but not labeled vegetarian since it's typically built on a meat sauce), and Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna (117 ratings). So the Artichoke Spinach Lasagna is the standout match.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Artichoke Spinach Lasagna, described vegetarian, rated 4.6 with 1,824 ratings and 1,287 reviews, satisfying all criteria.
